description: This line plot illustrates the similarity scores across layers for four different model configurations, labeled en&en, en&es, en&el, and en&bn, as defined in the legend. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 22, with integer tick marks at each whole number. The y-axis represents similarity, scaled linearly from 0.00 to 0.45, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The red solid line (en&en) starts near 0.07, rises to a peak of approximately 0.26 at layer 6, dips to about 0.15 around layer 8, and then declines to a low of approximately 0.07 at layer 20 before sharply increasing to nearly 0.45 at layer 22. The blue dashed line (en&es) follows a similar trend, starting near 0.07, peaking at approximately 0.25 at layer 6, dipping to around 0.14 at layer 10, and then declining to about 0.05 at layer 20 before rising to approximately 0.27 at layer 22. The green dashed line (en&el) begins near 0.04, rises to about 0.15 at layer 6, dips to approximately 0.09 at layer 8, and then declines to a low of about 0.05 at layer 20 before increasing to approximately 0.30 at layer 22. The pink dashed line (en&bn) starts near 0.04, rises to about 0.15 at layer 6, dips to approximately 0.09 at layer 8, and then declines to a low of about 0.05 at layer 20 before rising to approximately 0.30 at layer 22. All four lines show a general trend of increasing similarity in the final layers, with the red line (en&en) showing the most significant increase in the last few layers.
